positiveNegativeAssessment.credentialFreeEmptyScope: Explicit fresh data directory and absent kubeconfig; environment does not inherit API_TOKEN/KUBECONFIG; providers disabled; eight contexts responses assert contexts=[], configured=false, serverReadOnly=true. Headers contain no Authorization/Cookie. No response bodies persisted.

policyReview.assessment: Token-free raw Host is checked against localhost or net.ParseIP(...).IsLoopback before origin validation; hostile matching Host/Origin and omitted Origin therefore remain denied.

Missing Origin is allowed by policy; supplied Origin requires actual request scheme and equal Host, no user/path/query/fragment. Foreign or opaque Origin is denied; forwarded headers do not change r.Host or r.TLS.
Contexts/workspace/management/ws use protect; session calls guard(false) itself before method processing. Foreign GET /ws tests guard rejection, not WebSocket upgrade.
Public /api/version and /healthz, plus static frontend registration, lie outside gateway guard. Host denial cannot be claimed for all HTTP routes.

helperLimitations.assessment: Startup health checks are outside checks counter and the pre-request elapsed guard. The 30-second test limit is also checked retrospectively after cleanup. Recorded 3.6504584579997754 seconds meets actual elapsed limit, but this source does not enforce a global 30-second/60-request cap. Fixed 30-case matrix plus up to 40 health polls can issue up to 70 HTTP requests in other executions.
helperLimitations.disposition: Root acknowledged; separately corrected retest planned. No corrected run reviewed here.

helperLimitations.assessment: The statement that a positive follows every negative group is stronger than probe.py:87-105: positives precede the negative matrix, then forwarded-local positive and final local positive follow it. Functional liveness after negatives is established, subgroup interleaving is not.
